name: Saraswati, Phoenix of Sacred Knowledge
title: Phoenix of Sacred Knowledge
description: This NFT portrays Saraswati, goddess of wisdom, speech, and the arts, reimagined as a phoenix whose music gives form to thought. Sapphire and moon‑silver plumage with lilac and pearlescent gradients; flowing robes in cold cinematic light. She plays a traditional wooden veena; golden strings emit radiant sound waves and luminous notes across the void. She is the Phoenix of Sacred Knowledge — the lucid harmony that guides creation toward meaning.

attributes.value: Feathers: sapphire, silver; Instrument: sandalwood veena
